uz.title: Grammatika qoidalari: SAT uchun qisqa qo‘llanma
uz.summary: Standard English Conventions savollari uchun ixcham qoidalar to‘plami: gap chegaralari (comma splice, nuqtali vergul, ikki nuqta, tire, qo‘shimcha qismlar), ega va kesim moslashuvi, olmoshlar, fe’l zamonlari, aniqlovchi iboralar, egalik va apostrof — har biri qisqa inglizcha misol va “SAT buni qanday tekshiradi” maslahati bilan.

sections.heading: Bu savollar nimani tekshiradi
sections.body:
Standard English Conventions — Reading and Writing bo‘limining taxminan 26% i (11–15 ta savol). Savol doim bir xil: *Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?* Ikki ko‘nikma tekshiriladi:

- **Boundaries** (gap chegaralari) — gaplar va ularning qismlari tinish belgilari bilan qanday ajratiladi.
- **Form, Structure, and Sense** (shakl va moslik) — ega va kesim moslashuvi, olmoshlar, fe’l zamonlari va shakllari, aniqlovchi iboralar, ko‘plik va egalik.

Deyarli hamma qoida bitta tushunchaga tayanadi. **Mustaqil gap** (*independent clause*) — egasi va kesimi bor, yolg‘iz tura oladigan to‘liq fikr: *The lab closed early.* **Tobe gap** (*dependent clause*) *because, although, when, while, which* kabi so‘z bilan boshlanadi va yolg‘iz tura olmaydi: *because the lab closed early*.

Bu savollar tez yechiladi (30–50 soniya) va qoidalar cheklangan — ularni o‘rganish ballni oshirishning eng tez yo‘llaridan biri.

sections.heading: 1. Ikki mustaqil gapni bog‘lash
items: **To‘g‘ri usullar:** nuqta (.), nuqtali vergul (;), vergul + bog‘lovchi (*for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so* — inglizcha qisqacha FANBOYS) yoki, ikkinchi gap birinchisini tushuntirsa, ikki nuqta (:).

✗ **Comma splice:** *The lab closed early, the samples were moved.* — ikki mustaqil gap faqat vergul bilan ajratilgan.
✓ *The lab closed early; the samples were moved.*
✓ *The lab closed early, so the samples were moved.*
✗ **Run-on:** *The lab closed early the samples were moved.* — orada hech qanday belgi yo‘q.
✗ **Fragment:** *Because the lab closed early.* — tobe gap yolg‘iz qolgan. ✓ *Because the lab closed early, the samples were moved.*

**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** variantlarda so‘zlar bir xil, faqat tinish belgisi farq qiladi. Bo‘sh joyning **chap** va **o‘ng** tomonini alohida o‘qing. Ikkalasi ham mustaqil gap bo‘lsa — nuqta, nuqtali vergul yoki vergul + FANBOYS; bittasi mustaqil bo‘lmasa — vergul yoki hech narsa.

sections.heading: 2. Nuqtali vergul (;) va o‘tish so‘zlari
items: Nuqtali vergul nuqta kabi ishlaydi: **ikkala tomoni ham mustaqil gap** bo‘lishi shart. ✓ *The bridge opened in 1932; it is still in use.* ✗ *The bridge opened; in 1932.*

*however, therefore, moreover, nevertheless, for example* kabi o‘tish so‘zlari ikki mustaqil gapni o‘zi **bog‘lay olmaydi** — oldidan nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta kerak. ✓ *The data were limited; however, the trend was clear.* ✗ *The data were limited, however, the trend was clear.*
O‘tish so‘zi bitta gapning ichida kelsa, ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi: ✓ *The trend, however, was clear.*
**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** *however* yoki *therefore* atrofidagi belgilar. Avval aniqlang: o‘tish so‘zi ikki mustaqil gap chegarasidami (→ “;” yoki “.”) yoki bitta gap ichidami (→ ikki vergul)?

sections.heading: 3. Ikki nuqta (:)
items: Ikki nuqtadan **oldin to‘liq mustaqil gap** bo‘lishi kerak; undan keyin ro‘yxat, tushuntirish yoki misol keladi.
✓ *The team needed one thing: more time.* ✗ *The team needed: more time.*
✗ *The recipe includes: flour, salt, and water.* — fe’ldan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ikki nuqta qo‘yilmaydi. ✓ *The recipe includes flour, salt, and water.*
**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** ikki nuqtaning chap tomonini alohida o‘qing — u yolg‘iz to‘liq gap bo‘la oladimi? Ikki nuqta “ya’ni”, “aynan” ma’nosini beradi.

sections.heading: 4. Qo‘shimcha qismlar: vergul, tire, qavs
items: Gapdan olib tashlansa ma’no buzilmaydigan **qo‘shimcha** (*nonessential*) qism ikki tomondan **bir xil** belgi bilan ajratiladi: ikki vergul, ikki tire yoki ikki qavs.

✓ *The mural, painted in 1998, faces the river.*
✓ *The mural—painted in 1998—faces the river.*
✗ *The mural, painted in 1998—faces the river.* (belgilar har xil)
✗ *The mural, painted in 1998 faces the river.* (ikkinchi vergul yo‘q)
**Muhim** (*essential*) qism ajratilmaydi — u qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotganini aniqlaydi: ✓ *Students who arrive late must sign in.* (faqat kech kelganlar).

**Unvon va ism:** unvon yoki kasb ismdan oldin kelsa, orada vergul qo‘yilmaydi: ✓ *The biologist Ana Ruiz spoke first.* ✗ *The biologist, Ana Ruiz spoke first.* Ism oldin, izoh keyin kelsa — ikki vergul: ✓ *Ana Ruiz, a biologist, spoke first.*
**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** qo‘shimcha qism vergul yoki tire bilan boshlangan bo‘lsa, uning oxirida **xuddi shu** belgini qidiring.

sections.heading: 5. Keraksiz vergullar
items: Ega va kesim orasida vergul qo‘yilmaydi — ega uzun bo‘lsa ham: ✗ *The results of the long study, were surprising.* ✓ *The results of the long study were surprising.*
Fe’l va to‘ldiruvchi orasida ham: ✗ *The team discovered, a new species.* ✓ *The team discovered a new species.*
Bitta egaga tegishli ikki kesim *and* bilan bog‘lansa, vergul kerak emas: ✓ *He opened the box and found a key.*
Gap boshidagi tobe gap yoki kirish iborasidan keyin esa vergul qo‘yiladi: ✓ *Although it rained, the race continued.*
**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** variantlar orasida keraksiz vergulli variantlar ko‘p. Har bir vergulning sababini ayta olishingiz kerak — sabab bo‘lmasa, vergul ham bo‘lmasin.

sections.heading: 6. Ega va kesim moslashuvi (subject–verb agreement)
items: Birlik ega — birlik kesim (*is, was, has, does*, fe’l + *-s*); ko‘plik ega — ko‘plik kesim (*are, were, have, do*).
**Ega uzoqda bo‘lishi mumkin:** *of, in, with, among* bilan boshlangan iborani xayolan o‘chirib o‘qing. ✓ *The list of names is long.* — ega **list** (birlik), shuning uchun *is*.
*each, every, either, neither, everyone, everything* — birlik: ✓ *Each of the samples was tested.*
*and* bilan bog‘langan ega — ko‘plik: ✓ *The map and the compass were missing.*
Kesim egadan oldin kelsa ham, egaga moslashadi: ✓ *Among the findings were two surprises.* — ega **surprises**.
Jamlovchi otlar (*team, committee, group, audience*) odatda birlik: ✓ *The committee has decided.*
**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** variantlar *is/are*, *was/were*, *has/have*. Avval haqiqiy egani toping — bo‘sh joyga eng yaqin ot ko‘pincha tuzoq.

sections.heading: 7. Olmoshlar
items: Olmosh o‘zi almashtirgan ot bilan sonda moslashadi: ✓ *The companies released their reports.* ✓ *The company released its report.* ✗ *The company released their report.*
*its* — egalik (“uning”), *it’s* — *it is* qisqartmasi: ✓ *The bird built its nest.*
*their* — egalik (“ularning”), *they’re* — *they are*, *there* — “u yerda”.
*who* — odamlar uchun, *which* — narsalar uchun; *whose* — egalik, *who’s* — *who is*.
**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** olmosh qaysi otga ishora qilayotganini toping va uning sonini tekshiring: birlik bo‘lsa *it/its*, ko‘plik bo‘lsa *they/their*.

sections.heading: 8. Fe’l zamonlari va shakllari
items: **Zamonni matndan oling:** matndagi boshqa fe’llar o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lsa, odatda o‘tgan zamon kerak. ✓ *In 1910, the inventor tested a prototype and recorded the results.*
**Present perfect** (*has/have* + fe’lning 3-shakli) — o‘tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan: ✓ *Since 2015, the city has planted 4,000 trees.*
**Past perfect** (*had* + 3-shakl) — o‘tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin bo‘lgan: ✓ *By the time the rescuers arrived, the storm had passed.*
**Gapda asosiy fe’l bo‘lishi shart:** *-ing* shakli yoki *to* + fe’l yolg‘iz kesim bo‘la olmaydi. ✗ *The researchers analyzing the data.* ✓ *The researchers analyzed the data.*

**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** variantlar *analyzed / analyzing / to analyze / having analyzed*. Avval gapda boshqa asosiy fe’l bor-yo‘qligini aniqlang: yo‘q bo‘lsa — to‘liq kesim (*analyzed*) kerak; bor bo‘lsa — ko‘pincha *-ing* yoki *to* shakli.

sections.heading: 9. Aniqlovchi iboralar (modifiers)
items: Gap boshidagi aniqlovchi ibora verguldan keyingi **birinchi** otga tegishli bo‘ladi.
✗ *Walking to school, the rain started.* — yomg‘ir maktabga yurmaydi. ✓ *Walking to school, Dilnoza noticed the rain.*
✗ *Built in 1890, visitors still admire the tower.* — tashrif buyuruvchilar 1890-yilda qurilmagan. ✓ *Built in 1890, the tower is still admired by visitors.*

**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** variantlar verguldan keyingi qism qanday boshlanishi bilan farq qiladi. O‘zingizdan so‘rang: iboradagi ishni **kim** yoki **nima** bajargan? Aynan o‘sha so‘z verguldan keyin darhol kelishi kerak.

sections.heading: 10. Ko‘plik va egalik (apostrof)
items: **Birlik ot + ’s:** ✓ *the scientist’s notes* (bitta olim).
**-s bilan tugaydigan ko‘plik + ’:** ✓ *the scientists’ notes* (bir necha olim).
**-s siz ko‘plik + ’s:** ✓ *the children’s books*, ✓ *the women’s team*.
**Egalik olmoshlarida apostrof yo‘q:** *its, their, whose, ours, yours*.
**Oddiy ko‘plikda apostrof yo‘q:** ✓ *several samples*, ✓ *the 1990s*; ✗ *several sample’s*.

**SAT qanday tekshiradi:** variantlar *scientist’s / scientists’ / scientists / scientist*. Ikki savol bering: 1) bitta mi yoki ko‘p mi? 2) egalik bormi — ya’ni so‘zdan keyin u egalik qiladigan ot keladimi?

sections.heading: Grammatika savolini 4 qadamda yechish
steps: **Variantlarni ko‘ring:** nima farq qiladi — tinish belgisimi (Boundaries) yoki so‘z shakli (Form, Structure, and Sense)?
**Tinish belgisi bo‘lsa:** bo‘sh joyning chap va o‘ng tomonini aniqlang — mustaqil gapmi, tobe gapmi, qo‘shimcha qismmi? Keyin 1–5-qoidalarni qo‘llang.
**So‘z shakli bo‘lsa:** egani yoki olmosh almashtirgan otni toping, zamonni esa matndagi boshqa fe’llardan oling (6–10-qoidalar).
**Tanlangan variantni gapga qo‘yib, butun gapni bir marta o‘qing** va qoidani yana bir bor tekshiring. “Qulog‘imga yaxshi eshitiladi” — dalil emas: SAT tuzoqlari ko‘pincha tabiiy eshitiladi.

sections.heading: SAT’ning eng ko‘p uchraydigan tuzoqlari
items: Uzun ibora egani kesimdan uzoqlashtiradi — eng yaqin ot “yolg‘on ega” bo‘lib chiqadi.
*however* oldida vergul — ikki mustaqil gap orasida comma splice hosil qiladi.
Qo‘shimcha qism bir tomondan vergul, ikkinchi tomondan tire bilan ajratilgan.
Unvon va ism orasida vergul (*The biologist, Ana Ruiz…*).
Kesim o‘rnida *-ing* shakli — gap fe’lsiz qoladi.
*its/it’s* va *their/they’re* almashib ketadi.

sections.heading: Javobni tanlashdan oldin
items: Variantlar nimasi bilan farq qiladi — belgi yoki so‘z shakli?
Bo‘sh joyning ikki tomonidagi qismni aniqladimmi?
Haqiqiy egani yoki olmosh almashtirgan otni topdimmi?
Qo‘shimcha qismning ikki tomonida bir xil belgi bormi?
